spec.benchmark: Constant-mean expected return: the mean observed change over each event's own estimation window [-60,-11], estimated separately per event and per leg, on the lagged changes for the FRED legs
spec.cost_model: No cost gate: an event study measures announcement responses, not a forecast; there is no trading rule to cost
spec.description: FOMC event response under a one-day FRED publication lag: lagged CARs on [0,+1] for TYVIX, VIX, DGS10 and BAA10Y, with the SPX CAR unlagged as a control
model_definition: Constant-mean event study via the repo event_study() estimator (estimation window [-60,-11], event window [0,+1], overlap-cluster inference), mirroring study 005
FRED legs lagged one trading day on their own dates (diff-then-join, shift between diff and join); Yahoo SPX not shifted

One-sided p-values for the lagged volatility legs derived from the estimator z-statistic as Phi(z) for the 'less than' direction; two-sided p-values for lagged DGS10, lagged BAA10Y and the SPX control
Holm family of 5 tests (a lagged TYVIX, b lagged VIX, c lagged DGS10, d lagged BAA10Y, e SPX unlagged control); effect size is the standardized mean CAR
Descriptive per-day abnormal-return decomposition (day -1, 0, +1 contributions, unlagged) and descriptive unlagged replication on the truncated panel index (no p-values)

spec.primary_metric: Standardized mean lagged TYVIX CAR[0,+1] (mean CAR divided by the cross-event standard deviation of CARs)
spec.target_definition: Per-leg cumulative abnormal return over the lagged [0,+1] event window around scheduled FOMC statement days (FRED legs lagged one trading day: VIX and TYVIX log changes, DGS10 and BAA10Y level changes in basis points; SPX log return unlagged as an internal correctness control)

spec.benchmark: Own-history baseline: next-day SPX return predicted from its own lagged return only (BTC: its own lagged return)
spec.cost_model: Informational only: the S&P 500 index is not directly tradable and no free SPX futures or ETF price series is used in this study. The trial reports the gross sign-rule edge on holdout out-of-sample forecasts (no costs applied) as an informational assessment, not a verdict criterion; the out-of-sample incremental R-squared criterion carries the economic weight.
spec.description: Release-day-aligned CPI transmission: the latest published CPI MoM (step function) predicts next-day SPX returns (daily and release-day subsample) and next-day BTC returns
model_definition: Partial lead-lag OLS with HAC standard errors (daily SPX, release-day SPX subsample, daily BTC)
Purged walk-forward out-of-sample evaluation (initial train 365 days, test 90 days, 1-day embargo), mirroring study 006
Cost gate informational only: the gross sign-rule edge on holdout out-of-sample forecasts (no costs applied), with a block-bootstrap confidence interval; not a verdict criterion

Descriptive naive alignment: the same three regressions with the CPI MoM aligned by reference month (the month's value treated as known during the month, 2-6 weeks of lookahead), compared against the PIT step to quantify the lookahead bias; not in the test family
spec.primary_metric: Partial R-squared of the CPI step predictor in the daily SPX lead-lag regression
spec.target_definition: Next-day close-to-close S&P 500 log return (daily primary and release-day subsample); next-day BTC-USDT perpetual log return (robustness)

cost_gate_informational.note: Informational only: no costs applied. The S&P 500 index is not directly tradable and no free SPX futures or ETF price series is used. Not a verdict criterion.

descriptive_naive.note: Naive reference-month alignment: the reference month's MoM treated as known during the month (2-6 weeks of lookahead). Descriptive only, not in the test family; coefficients and partial R-squared only, no p-values. Rows in October-November 2025 have no naive value (their reference months' MoM is undefined) and are dropped.
